analytical_findings.statement: Winchester Pre-U published D1–M1 exceeds honest D1–D3 by about 10.9 percentage points on average, roughly 9–14 points.
The folded ruler reverses Eton–Winchester ordering in all eight locked Pre-U comparison years; on honest D1–D3 Winchester trails Eton.
Winchester Oxbridge count decomposition: 45=33%×136 baseline vs 39=21%×185 current; cohort effect +16, rate effect −22, net −6, rate effect 1.4× cohort effect, relative rate fall −36%.
Westminster is the strict-spine benchmark but its exam and destination layers must remain split by basis.
KCS is a three-layer case: school offers, strict Apply-Centre, and leaver destinations. The apparent 2018–19 places-over-offers problem vanishes when Oxford FOI offers replace school undercounts.
SPGS 2025's ~47% destination intensity is a point outlier; the Oxford side is high-normal against its 18-year spine and the anomaly is Cambridge-side.
Wycombe's Oxford decline is structural: acceptances 13–21 across 2006–11 versus 5/9/10 in 2021–23.

definitions.matriculations: Pupils who actually enrolled. May differ from acceptances due to deferral, conditions, and changes of plan.
definitions.missingness: Use null/blanks; never delete an asymmetrical row or fabricate a comparator.
definitions.offers: Conditional or unconditional offers made. A leading indicator; not final attendance.
definitions.pandemic: CAG 2020 and TAG 2021 rows are quarantined from normal examined-year trend analysis.
definitions.strict_cycle: Applications/offers/final acceptances for one UCAS/apply-centre cycle. Quarantined from destinations/current-cycle offers.

implementation_guardrails: Every chart/filter must expose basis (offer, acceptance, matriculation, destination, exam entry), period, denominator, confidence, and source/version.
Default comparisons must be metric-pure; cross-basis overlays require an explicit warning and different visual encoding.
Show competing values rather than silently choosing when conflicts remain.
Use corrected cells from the corrections table; never revive superseded headline figures.
Keep v13 full-table rows available even when v14.6 elides them.
Treat 2020 CAG and 2021 TAG as quarantined.
Do not infer missing Cambridge splits or SPGS 2025 A*/A.

For Winchester 2015, keep the coherent 443-entry original Pre-U table separate from the later 444-entry accounts version. For 2017/2019 D1–M1, primary raw-count variants control and later league candidates remain distinct. Keep the 2021 mixed A-level/Pre-U TAG ruler out of both pure trends.
